name: run2019
caption:
THE 2019 RUN 🎮🏆 From a trade nobody was sure about to the first title in franchise history.

• July 2018: DeRozan for Kawhi
• 58-24, 2nd in the East
• Round 1: Magic in 5
• Round 2: THE SHOT. Game 7 vs Philly, 4 bounces, 92-90
• East Finals: down 0-2 to the Bucks, then 4 straight
• Finals: Warriors in 6, 114-110 at Oracle
• Kawhi: Finals MVP

Best Raptors moment ever? 👇

beats.head: THE 2019 RUN
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: July 2018. The Raptors trade DeMar DeRozan for Kawhi Leonard, with one year left on his deal.
beats.dlg: JULY 2018: THE RAPTORS|TRADE FOR KAWHI LEONARD.

beats.head: TRAINER CARD
beats.vo: The Raptors finish fifty-eight and twenty-four. Second in the East.

beats.head: ROUND 1: MAGIC
beats.vo: Round one: Orlando. Gone in five.

beats.head: THE SHOT
beats.name: KAWHI
beats.vo: Round two. Game seven against Philly, tied with four seconds left. Kawhi, from the corner... four bounces... and in.
beats.dlg: GAME 7 VS PHILLY. TIED...|4 BOUNCES... AND IN!

beats.head: EAST FINALS: BUCKS
beats.vo: East finals: Milwaukee. Down oh and two... then four straight wins.
beats.dlg: DOWN 0-2 TO THE BUCKS...|THEN 4 STRAIGHT WINS!

beats.head: THE FINALS
beats.vo: The Finals: Golden State. Game six, at Oracle. One fourteen, one ten.

beats.head: CHAMPIONS!
beats.vo: Four badges. One championship. And Kawhi, Finals MVP.

beats.head: WE THE NORTH
beats.vo: Best Raptors moment ever? Comment below.
